method: Public pages only, human pace, no sign-ups, no messages, no AliExpress. Sources read: Alibaba supplier-profile pages (suppliers.alibaba.com, certificate tables), Made-in-China.com and HKTDC supplier and product pages, supplier own sites, and a search engine used as a text reader for a few PDFs I could not open myself. Product images were viewed to guess style fit. No scraping API, no user-agent tricks. Stopped at every block (listed in blocked_or_unreadable).
grading_note: Strict, as in BRIEF-certified-lighting-cn.md. A = lab report or certificate for the model or a named family (lab and number visible) plus a DoC: none found. B = supplier-level certificate from an accredited lab covering lighting, no model numbers. C = claim only, or numbers with the lab unnamed ('Other' on Alibaba). Alibaba 'Verified by SGS / TUV Rheinland / Intertek' badges are SUPPLIER AUDITS, not product certificates, and are not counted. ETL (Intertek) is a North American listing, not EN 60598, and is not counted as EU evidence. Style fit is a guess from title and one image; master-designer has not scored anything.
acceptance_status: NOT MET: no A, two B, and neither B supplier has two products with style fit >= 7 in a style that needs the slot. Stated honestly instead of padding with C.
economics_note: Formula from the brief: landed = (unit + shipping) x 3.3; net = price / 1.18; contribution = net - landed - (0.02 x price + 1.2) - 0.08 x net. CNY converted at 7.2 per USD (assumption). ship_usd_il is null everywhere because no supplier published a shipping quote to Israel; margin_pct_est is null for the same reason. Each product note gives the best-case margin at shipping = 0 and the shipping budget that still leaves 40 percent. Reference for real freight: results/wave3-repricing.md (AliExpress express for 40-55 cm pendants USD 94-266, floor lamps up to USD 718) and docs/suppliers/zendrop-test-2026-10.md (Zendrop estimate for a 1-1.5 kg wall lamp to Israel USD 35.05, 14 days).

(2) HKTDC-hosted IEC 60598-2-1 test report, report no. GZES160801291601, dated 2017-03-20, lab SGS-CSTC Standards Technical Services (Guangzhou), applicant and manufacturer Zhongshan Jumei Lighting, LED ceiling luminaire Class I IP20, models MX2054/S, MX2035/S, MX2035/M, ML8004B, MX2043: https://sourcing-media.hktdc.com/original-file/ba6b48fbc5dd4e63832c386e25092ad1?ext=.pdf&bucket=PUBLIC_ACCESS_MEDIA_BUCKET . I could NOT open this PDF with my tools (scanned or encrypted); the text above comes from a search-engine summary of it, so a human must open it. Graded B, not A, because no DoC was seen and the report covers ceiling luminaires only. The maker describes itself as a designer and maker of Scandinavian-inspired fixtures (pendants, ceilings, wall sconces, floor and table lamps): https://www.shine.lighting/jumei/ .
suppliers.red_flags: Report is from 2017 (old editions, ceiling luminaires only, no EMC report seen, no DoC seen). HKTDC certificate entries are self-declared. HKTDC product pages show commercial downlights and one aluminium wall light, not the Scandinavian range. My fetch of maglung.net returned HTTP 503, so the decor catalogue was not reached.
suppliers.shipping_note: HKTDC lists Eastern Europe, North America, Scandinavia, Southeast Asia, Western Europe as markets; Israel not named. The one HKTDC product page read (Convex Lens Wall Light, https://sourcing.hktdc.com/en/Product-Detail/Convex-Lens-Wall-Light-1X26DU0I) shows MOQ 1 piece, 21 days production, FOB Zhongshan. No flat-pack information.

suppliers.question_draft_en: We are a design-led home brand selling to Israel (220-240V, 50Hz). At retail price the landed cost is ILS 429 against a single-sconce Israeli value of about ILS 349; a trade price would be needed. margin_pct_est is rough: (net 296 - landed 429 - fees 32) / 296.

suppliers.question_draft_en: Who manufactures your travertine lamps, and do you hold CE, LVD and EMC documents (DoC and accredited-lab test reports) for the wall and pendant models? What is the trade-program price for 4-10 units, and what is the real delivery time to Israel?

suppliers.name: Zendrop
suppliers.evidence: Zendrop support article: the DoC is 'the most important document'; test reports should match the exact model and come from an ISO/IEC 17025 lab; 'if a supplier cannot provide a DoC, the product should be treated as non-compliant'; Zendrop can ask suppliers and its warehouse team can check documents, but 'in some cases, certificates are only provided after an order has been placed'. No lighting-specific policy and no pre-held documents.
suppliers.red_flags: Policy text only. Catalogue shows no certificate fields (docs/suppliers/zendrop-test-2026-10.md). Zendrop lamp estimate to Israel: wall lamp 1.05-1.52 kg USD 35.05, 14 days.
suppliers.shipping_note: From docs/suppliers/zendrop-test-2026-10.md: one 'regular' option, 14 days, for China-origin items; US-supplier items have no Israel option; lamps and other 1 kg items cost USD 35-44 each.
suppliers.question_draft_en: Before listing, can you obtain the EU DoC and the LVD (EN 60598) and EMC test reports for this specific lighting SKU, and tell us which suppliers hold them? Do you ship it to Israel, and at what cost and time?

suppliers.name: CJdropshipping
suppliers.evidence: CJ developer docs expose a product field hasCECertification (0 or 1): a flag, not a document (read through a search-engine summary of that page). CJ blogs say suppliers should provide CE markings on request. No lighting compliance policy found: https://cjdropshipping.com/sourcing , https://cjdropshipping.com/contactus
suppliers.red_flags: Flag only. Project notes (studio-rules ה.9) cite 'CJ does not ship to Israel' as an example for some products; not re-verified here. Plain mismatch with the owner's request for model-level reports.
suppliers.shipping_note: docs/suppliers/zendrop-test-2026-10.md quotes a CJ median shipping of USD 16.59, 12-50 days. CJ sourcing requests (My CJ > Sourcing) are the route to ask for a lighting SKU with documents.
suppliers.question_draft_en: For this lighting SKU (hasCECertification = 1), please send the EU DoC and the LVD (EN 60598) and EMC test reports with lab name and report numbers, and confirm shipping to Israel with cost and time.

suppliers.name: HyperSKU
suppliers.evidence: Home page: '2,000+ vetted dropshipping suppliers', '10+ global warehouses', '5-12 days global shipping with address validation', 'Quality control with sample comparison and supplier validation'. No mention of CE, compliance, lighting or Israel: https://www.hypersku.com/
suppliers.red_flags: Nothing on compliance documents; no country list.
suppliers.shipping_note: No destination list; country pages exist for US, UK, Poland, Australia. No fees beyond products and fulfilment ('no subscription').
suppliers.question_draft_en: Do you hold or can you obtain the EU DoC and LVD/EMC test reports for lighting products from your vetted suppliers, and do you ship single units to Israel?

suppliers.name: Sourcinbox
suppliers.evidence: Home page presents a dropshipping agent with integrations (Shopify, WooCommerce, Etsy and others); no statement on compliance, CE, lighting, MOQ or destinations: https://www.sourcinbox.com/
suppliers.red_flags: Nothing to grade; no policy found.
suppliers.shipping_note: Not stated on the home page.
suppliers.question_draft_en: Can you source lighting with an EU DoC and LVD/EMC test reports per model, and ship single units to Israel?

suppliers.name: Wiio
suppliers.evidence: Home page (Portuguese): 'sem quantidade minima de pedidos', delivery '6 a 15 dias', customs-clearance guarantee, free storage up to 60 days. No mention of compliance, CE or lighting: https://www.wiio.io/
suppliers.red_flags: A customs-clearance guarantee is not a compliance statement.
suppliers.shipping_note: No country list; one testimonial claims 1-2 weeks to any country.
suppliers.question_draft_en: Can you source lighting with an EU DoC and LVD/EMC test reports per model, and ship single units to Israel with customs handling?

Returned a 'SuperJS check' page (bot check) and HTTP 429 on its LVD report PDFs; stopped. V-TAC publishes LVD reports with lab names (v-tac.eu/images/certificates/Certificates-2023/); its decor range was not examined.
HTTP 503 (Jumei's brand site); the decor catalogue was not reached.
HTTP 503. A directory snippet claims TUV GS, CE and ENEC for Zhongshan IkerDecor; unverified.
HTTP 403; CE and Israel shipping not verified.
Supplier-uploaded LVD and CE PDFs (scanned or encrypted) cannot be parsed by my tools; the few I mention were read only through a search-engine summary and must be opened by a human.
Product pages return empty text; only supplier-profile pages on suppliers.alibaba.com can be read. Alibaba messaging needs an account, so nothing was sent.

summary_he: גל מחקר ספקי תאורה סיניים עם תקינה (2026-10-14), דירוג קפדני לפי הבריף: A: 0. B: 2 (Zhongshan Jumei, דוח SGS-CSTC מ-2017 על גופי תקרה; Guangzhou Beacon Peace, תעודת CB של Intertek לגופי תאורה). C: 14. קריטריון הקבלה לא התקיים: אין 5 ספקים ברמה A או B, ולאף ספק B אין שני מוצרים עם התאמת סגנון 7 ומעלה בסגנון שצריך את העמדה. כל הדירוגים נשענים על דפים ציבוריים בלבד, ושום מסמך לא נמצא ברשותנו. תגיות Verified של Alibaba הן ביקורת ספק ולא תעודת מוצר. שלושת המובילים לפנייה (באישור המשתמש בלבד): Tonghai (מנורות עמידה לבוהו, ים-תיכוני וכפרי מודרני), Maso (מנורת עמידה במבוק לבוהו, מסמכים לפי דרישה ומייל ציבורי), Well House יחד עם Olopo (תלויות קלועות 45 ומעלה לאוכל, סלון והורים בים-תיכוני ובוהו). בעיית המשלוח של מנורות גדולות לא נפתרה: אצל אף ספק אין מחיר משלוח לישראל או אריזה שטוחה מוצהרת. פערים שלא נמצא להם אף ספק: מנורת קיר עם אהיל פשתן, מנורת שולחן לכניסה ולעבודה, מנורות תמונה, ותאורת אמבטיה IP44.
